refunds.annual_plan_note: Annual subscriptions are non-refundable after 14 days because the discount is amortised over the term. This overrides the standard 30-day window for any plan with billing_cycle = annual.
refunds.pro_rated_policy: Monthly plans are refunded pro rata by unused whole days.
refunds.service_credit_policy: Service credits are discretionary. Agents may not issue service credits without supervisor approval regardless of ticket value.
refunds.partial_refund_ceiling_note: Partial refunds up to and including this amount may be issued by a support agent without additional approval, provided the ticket is inside its refund window. Above this amount, billing supervisor approval is mandatory.

P2.label: Major - core feature degraded, no workaround

sla.clock_stop_note: SLA clocks pause while a ticket sits in one of the listed states. Tickets in awaiting_customer_response must not be counted as breached.

escalation.data_breach_rule: Any suspected data breach must be escalated to the security-incident channel and P1 regardless of customer count.

approvals.note: The agent may auto-execute reversible, in-window actions. Anything that moves money or terminates a contract requires an explicit human decision, recorded with approver identity and reason.

entitlements.trial_extension_note: A trial may be extended at most once, by at most 14 days. Further extensions must be approved by the account manager.

conflicts_on_purpose.note: This file intentionally disagrees with kb/billing-and-refunds.md and structured/catalog.csv on some values. The agent is expected to detect the disagreement from evidence, not to silently pick a side.
known_disagreements: kb/billing-and-refunds.md says a 30-day refund window for all plans; refunds.annual_plan_window_days says 14 for annual plans
catalog.csv lists Growth at 499 USD/month; kb/billing-and-refunds.md says 450 USD/month
